caption: The drawing depicts a single, dark brown, metal door latch mounted on a vertical rectangular backplate. The backplate features six evenly spaced round holes along its length, three on each side of the central axis, potentially for mounting with screws. The top and bottom edges of the backplate are ornate, with decorative round and curved shapes. Protruding horizontally from the central section of the backplate are two handles: the upper handle is a curved lever with a slight upward tilt and flattened end, while the lower handle is a turned, spindle-shaped grip with a rounded tip and two bulges along its length. The background of the drawing is plain, off-white, and untextured, providing strong contrast to the dark, rusted appearance of the latch hardware. The artist’s signature and date are inscribed in small red-brown text in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Norfolk Latch
